Equivalent current-byte production/prototype Overview and Repositories evidence in dark Simplified Chinese and light English at 1600x1000 and 390x844, with administrator and normal-user or read-only representatives plus populated and empty or partial-failure data states.

A strict verifier proving exact state inventory, routes, viewports, theme, locale, role, data state, content, local/page overflow, raw i18n absence, browser health, PNG integrity, service identity, source hashes, one run ID, and a rejected negative mutation.

stop_condition: Stop if closure needs files outside the locked scope, a new product or backend contract, unsupported prototype data, non-reproducible equivalent states, or parity and task claims outside rows 2-3 and baseline task 6.1.
